back: Effective leaders have particular personal qualities; limitation: successful leaders differ and the situation matters.
Effective leadership depends on what leaders do and can be learned; includes Blake and Mouton's grid.
Concern for production (task) against concern for people, each 1 to 9: impoverished 1,1; country club 1,9; authority-compliance 9,1; middle of the road 5,5; team management 9,9.
No single best style; the best leadership depends on the task, the followers and the circumstances.
Legitimate (position), reward, coercive (punishment), expert (skill) and referent (respect).
Inspires followers with a shared vision to achieve more and to carry out major change; contrasts with transactional leadership.
Leadership based on exchanging rewards for performance and keeping routine running.
Self-awareness, self-management, social awareness and social skills.
Trait for selection, behavioural for training, contingency for flexibility, power for influence, transformational for change.
